_comment: Staging fragment for ONE Clek-Liing/Liingo-compatible STROLLER. Copy to <option-id>.json (filename MUST equal the id in _ROSTER.md / the seed.json 'clek-stroller' module), fill EVERY field, commit ONLY this file + its image. Do NOT edit seed.json — the integration pass folds all fragments into the two new modules and bumps dataVersion once. Gate: the model MUST appear in _CLEK_LIST.md. See ../../CLEK_COMPAT_RESEARCH_PLAN.md + ../../SOURCING.md.
name: Human-readable model name (e.g. 'Bugaboo Butterfly')

clekListed._comment: Proof this model is on Clek's definitive list — required before any other sourcing.

specs._comment: LITERAL, sourced numbers. Every value must trace to a manufacturer/retailer spec page in sources[]. Use inches + pounds (US). If a spec is genuinely unpublished, set null and say so in notes — do not guess.

brake._comment: Does it have a brake, and what kind?
brake.type: e.g. foot-operated parking brake / hand brake / auto-lock / one-step linked

capacity.minAgeOrNewborn: e.g. birth (with car seat / bassinet) / 6 mo+

safety._comment: Safety tests / standards the stroller (not the car seat) meets. Cite the source.
safety.standards: e.g. ASTM F833; JPMA certified; EN 1888 — list what the maker/retailer publishes
safety.certifications: e.g. JPMA Certified; Greenguard Gold (fabric); etc.
safety.notes: 5-point harness? auto-lock fold latch? wrist strap? etc.

specs.foldType: e.g. one-hand self-standing / two-step / cabin-approved travel fold
specs.strollerType: e.g. compact/travel · full-size · jogger · double · wagon · modular
specs.recline: e.g. multi-position to near-flat / single recline
specs.tires: wheel/tire type + size (air-filled vs foam vs plastic)

sources: https://manufacturer-spec-page (weight / folded + unfolded dims / capacity / brake / safety)
notes: Current gen vs superseded; in-stock vs backorder; MSRP vs sale; how it serves the light/compact city+shopping goal vs the owned BOB Alterrain Pro (trips/jogging); any spec Clek's handle-position/max-weight caveat affects.
